integrity: An explicit algebraic proof and an exact-integer reproducible verifier are supplied. Finite checks corroborate but are not the infinite proof. No claim of independent certification or absolute historical uniqueness is made.
scientific_limitations: The classification assumes \(a,b\ge1\) and odd prime \(p>2^a+1\) for \(n=2^a p^b\).
The Cantor limit fixes a and p and varies b only.
Independent mathematical audit and historical-priority verification beyond inspected texts have not been performed.
The exact-dimensional limiting measure models uniformly selected monic divisors; other sampling laws and their multifractal behavior are outside scope.
title: Exact divisor-degree fibers, gap lengths and a Cantor limit beyond the two-prime \(\varphi\)-practical threshold
